title: TrustFix: Price updates, service isolation, booking form options, and WhatsApp button wiring

requirements.text: In frontend/src/data/services.ts, reduce every painting package price by exactly ₹1. For example: ₹18/sqft → ₹17/sqft, ₹19 → ₹18, ₹17 → ₹16, ₹13 → ₹12, ₹9 → ₹8, ₹5 → ₹4. Apply to all painting service entries. Do not change any other field, layout, or card design.

quotes: All painting package prices must be ₹1 LESS

acceptanceCriteria: Every painting package price shown in the UI is exactly ₹1 lower than before.
No painting card layout, color, or image is changed.
No other service prices are affected.

requirements.text: In frontend/src/data/services.ts and frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceCard.tsx, update cleaning service prices to: Bathroom – ₹449, Sofa – ₹699, Mattress – ₹799, Kitchen – ₹1499. For home cleaning, set prices to: 1BHK Vacant – ₹2499, 1BHK Occupied – ₹3499, 2BHK Vacant – ₹3999, 2BHK Occupied – ₹4999, 3BHK Vacant – ₹5999, 3BHK Occupied – ₹6999. For Villa, Commercial, and Carpet cleaning entries, replace the price display with the flow label 'Free Inspection → Quote → Service'. Do not change card layout or design.

quotes: Villa / Commercial / Carpet: Show "Free inspection → Quote → Service"

acceptanceCriteria: Bathroom shows ₹449, Sofa shows ₹699, Mattress shows ₹799, Kitchen shows ₹1499.
Home cleaning cards show all six BHK/occupancy tiers with the correct prices.
Villa, Commercial, and Carpet cards display 'Free Inspection → Quote → Service' instead of a numeric price.
No other cleaning card visuals are changed.

requirements.text: In frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx, ensure that when a user navigates to or selects the Pest Control, Cleaning, or Painting service, only that service's own subcategory cards are rendered. No cards or sections from other services must appear on the same view. The service detail page must be fully isolated per service.

quotes: When user clicks: Pest Control / Cleaning / Painting — Show ONLY that service's subcategories. Do NOT show other services.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/navigating to Pest Control shows only pest control subcategory cards.
Clicking/navigating to Cleaning shows only cleaning subcategory cards.
Clicking/navigating to Painting shows only painting subcategory cards.
No cards from other service categories appear on any of these pages.

requirements.text: In frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx, for bookings where the service type is Pest Control, Cleaning, or Painting, add a 'Property Type' select field with options: 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, Square Feet, Villa, Commercial. This field should only be visible when one of these three service types is selected. Do not change the booking form layout for other service types.

quotes: Only for Pest Control / Cleaning / Painting: Add options: 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, Square Feet, Villa, Commercial

acceptanceCriteria: When Pest Control, Cleaning, or Painting is selected as the service type, a Property Type field appears with the six options.
The Property Type field is hidden for other service types.
The selected property type is included in the booking submission payload.

requirements.text: Update every button and CTA in the frontend — including 'Free Inspection', 'Book Now', 'Call', and the floating WhatsApp button — to open the URL https://wa.me/918884447229. Verify this applies to: FloatingWhatsAppButton.tsx, HeroSection.tsx, PestControlCard.tsx, CleaningServiceCard.tsx, PaintingServiceCard.tsx, ServiceCard.tsx, SubcategoryCard.tsx, and any other component with a booking or call CTA. Do not change button appearance or layout.

quotes: All buttons: Free Inspection / Book Now / Call / Floating button — Must open WhatsApp: https://wa.me/918884447229

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Free Inspection' on any card opens https://wa.me/918884447229.
Clicking 'Book Now' on any card opens https://wa.me/918884447229.
The floating WhatsApp button opens https://wa.me/918884447229.
No button style or position is changed.

constraints: Do NOT change the TrustFix UI layout, color scheme, typography, header, or card designs.
Do NOT rebuild or redesign any page or component.
Only modify data values, price figures, button href targets, and conditional rendering logic.
The WhatsApp number used in all CTAs must be exactly +918884447229 (https://wa.me/918884447229).
nonGoals: Changing prices for any service other than Painting and Cleaning.
Adding property type options to service types other than Pest Control, Cleaning, and Painting.
Backend schema changes (no new data models required for these updates).
